method: Nine pose-specific full portrait edits. Only independently registered brow areas are composited at native one-to-one scale. Actual PNG output bytes are preserved without painting or pixel cleanup.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one full source portrait for native-size local 2D VTuber eyebrow compositing.
Input image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET: approved short blue-gray tomboy-haired character, fixed pose viewer-left-facing with chin raised. Near brow on viewer RIGHT x450..589 y340..366: inner root x450, outer tail x589. Far brow on viewer LEFT x308..364 y365..382: inner root x364, outer tail x308. Preserve original 1122x1402 portrait framing.
Change ONLY BOTH EYEBROWS and the tiny forehead skin areas needed to cleanly remove their previous strokes. Raise the INNER ends nearest the nose of BOTH eyebrows by about 12–15 source pixels, curving smoothly back to the outer tails which remain nearly fixed. Gentle concerned / pleading brows. Not a uniform translation. The far brow's visible inner segment must also visibly lift.
Keep the original desaturated gray-violet/gray-brown matte color, fine soft tapered stroke quality, original length and visual weight. Do not turn eyebrows into shining silver hair, black thick makeup or oversized expressive arcs. Preserve the near/far brow perspective. Maintain all foreground bangs at EXACT original coordinates and boundaries; brows lie behind substantial hair, retaining only the original stylized faint visibility through thin hair strands. Do not move hair to expose the brows. Only one clean brow stroke per side, no double old/new marks.
LOCK ALL OTHER CONTENT: same head pose, face contour, chin, nose, tiny neutral thin-line mouth, open eyes with identical gaze/lids/iris/highlights/crease, skin shading, short hair silhouette and every strand, human ears, clothes, shoulders and lavender-gray background. No head rotation, scaling, crop, mirror, new accessories, text or comparison sheet. Return one same-size full portrait.
